description: Versioned conformance case registry mapping advertised Kafka APIs, versions, broker qualification cells, and behavioral regressions to immutable source pins and honest dispositions.

disposition_enum.independent_pass: Independently validated pass against external Apache Java or live broker oracle without relying on partitionline self-encoding. Zero cases qualify at audit baseline.
disposition_enum.local_consistency: Local encoder/decoder self-round-trip consistency or historical Docker smoke test; verifies internal consistency but is not an independent oracle.
disposition_enum.failed: Known failing test or reproduced defect verified against specification / reference behavior.
disposition_enum.not_run: Defined test case or target cell awaiting test runner, adapter, or CI environment.
disposition_enum.unsupported: API version, feature, or protocol capability intentionally unhandled or unimplemented; remains in denominator for completeness.
disposition_enum.blocked: Execution blocked on missing external prerequisite (e.g. Java fixture generator KL01-03+ or live test environment); remains in denominator.
disposition_enum.not_applicable: Inapplicable case (e.g. broker-internal clusterAction RPC out of client SDK scope); excluded from denominator (denominator: false); requires explicit reason.

Produce.notes: Versions 0-2 removed in Kafka 4.0; v12 is KIP-890 Part 2 txn V2; v13+ adds topic IDs (unsupported in client).

Fetch.notes: Versions 0-3 legacy; v12+ flexible; v17 KIP-853; v18+ KIP-1166 HighWatermark (unsupported in client).

Metadata.notes: v0 legacy; v9+ flexible; v10 topic IDs; v13 top-level ErrorCode (Kafka 4.0+ only).

ListOffsets.notes: v0 legacy; v6+ flexible; v7 max timestamp; v8 earliest local; v9 latest tiered; v10 TimeoutMs (Kafka 4.0+ only); v11+ (Kafka 4.3+, unsupported in client).

historical_executed.limits: KIP-848 and share group cases explicitly skipped in 3.9.1 cell; smoke coverage only, not a full independent pass of all cases.

Audit regression A01 (KL03-04): Assign offset 2; broker returns batch 0..2. Client returns [0, 1, 2] instead of [2]. apply_fetch_body lacks lower-bound check against requested offset. Reproduced in docs/audits/2026-09-21-consumer-probes.rs; client-semantic reproduction, not independent wire-conformance.

Audit regression A02 (KL03-03): PID 7 aborts txn at offset 0 (marker 1), commits at 2 (marker 3). read_committed should return [2]; returns [] and advances past data because control batch skips without ending the aborted-PID interval. Reproduced in docs/audits/2026-09-21-consumer-probes.rs; client-semantic reproduction, not independent wire-conformance.

Audit regression A03 (KL03-02): One partition succeeds while another returns retriable error. Delivered record disappears from application delivery because retry branch discards round-local out vector. Reproduced in docs/audits/2026-09-21-consumer-probes.rs; client-semantic reproduction, not independent wire-conformance.

Audit regression A04 (KL03-05): With auto.offset.reset=None, Fetch reports OFFSET_OUT_OF_RANGE and log start 10. Expected error and unchanged position 0; client resets unconditionally to log start 10. Reproduced in docs/audits/2026-09-21-consumer-probes.rs; client-semantic reproduction, not independent wire-conformance.

Audit regression A05 (KL03-06, KL03-07): Fetch 3 records with max_poll_records=1; process offset 0, commit(), leave and rejoin. Expected [1, 2]; received [] because fetch cursor advances before buffering excess records and commits cursor instead of delivered position. Reproduced in docs/audits/2026-09-21-consumer-probes.rs; client-semantic reproduction, not independent wire-conformance.
